事故后的第三天，王建新没有闲着。

他在厂区大礼堂组织了一场卫生知识讲座。医疗队和医务室全体人员都参加了，连张文华也来了，坐在台下第一排，面前摊着笔记本，手里握着钢笔。这是他头一回主动坐到第一排。

工人们下了班，陆陆续续往大礼堂走。有的穿着灰色工装，有的穿着蓝色工装，有的还戴着安全帽，帽子上沾着灰。有的一边走路一边抽烟，烟头在暮色里一明一暗的。大礼堂里坐了大几百人，黑压压的，连过道都站满了。

王建新站在台上，没有讲稿，就一张嘴。

“工友们，我们这次来不光是为了看病，也是为了教大家如何少生病、不生病。”他的声音不大，但大礼堂里每个人都听得清清楚楚。“伟人说，预防为主。最好的医生是不得病。”

他讲工伤预防。轧钢车间怎么防钢坯跑偏，高炉车间怎么防煤气泄漏，焦化车间怎么防化学灼伤。他讲的都是具体的事，不喊口号，不念文件，工人们听得进去。

“你们在车间干活，安全帽一定要戴好。别嫌热，别嫌沉。脑袋不比帽子金贵？”台下有人笑了。

他讲急救知识。出了工伤怎么办，流血了怎么止血，骨折了怎么固定，烫伤了怎么处理。他一边讲一边做示范，用绷带、夹板、止血带，一样一样地演示。刘晓东在旁边当“伤员”，被王建新翻过来翻过去，捆得像个粽子，台下的工人们笑得前仰后合。

他讲常见病防治。腰疼的、膝盖疼的、胃疼的、头疼的，怎么预防，怎么缓解，什么时候该来医务室，什么时候该去医院。他讲得简单，听得懂，记得住。

“你们下了班，别光顾着喝酒打牌。出去走走，活动活动筋骨。你这身子骨，是给国家干活的，不是给你糟蹋的。”

他讲个人卫生。勤洗手、勤洗澡、勤换衣服。夏天别喝生水，冬天别冻着。吃饭别凑合，睡觉别将就。

“你们在厂里流汗，家里老婆孩子指着你们呢。你把自己身体搞垮了，对得起谁？”

台下有人低着头，有人抹眼睛。

讲座结束后，王建新在厂区门口设立了一个简易的医疗咨询点，每天下午对外开放。一个临时棚子，四根木桩撑着一块帆布，摆了一张长条桌、几把折叠椅。桌上铺着白布，摆着血压计、听诊器、一本登记簿。刘晓东用毛笔写了块牌子——“医疗咨询点”，挂在棚子前面，字写得歪歪扭扭的，但看得清楚。

来的人络绎不绝。有问腰疼的，有问膝盖疼的，有问头晕的，有问失眠的。有的工人下了班不回家，先来咨询点坐一会儿，量量血压，问问身体。王建新一个一个地解答，不急不躁。能当场处理的他当场处理，处理不了的他写在纸上，让他们第二天来医务室。

刘晓东在旁边登记，一五一十地记下来，工号、姓名、车间、主诉、处理意见，写得工工整整。半个月下来，登记簿用了厚厚两大本。

王建新继续在医务室坐诊。

这天来了个老工人，五十来岁，背微微驼着，脸上的皱纹像刀刻的。他捂着胃，慢慢走进来，坐在诊桌前面，喘了口气。

“同志，我胃疼了好几年了，吃什么都疼，怎么办？”

王建新让他躺到检查床上，用神识探查了一下。慢性萎缩性胃炎，胃黏膜严重萎缩，肠上皮化生，属于癌前病变。再拖几年，可能就是胃癌了。

他用针刺中脘、内关、足三里，银针刺入，灵力缓缓渗入，温养胃腑。然后开了一张方子——香砂六君子汤加减，木香、砂仁、党参、白术、茯苓、甘草、陈皮、半夏、生姜、大枣。健脾和胃，行气止痛。

三剂药下去，老工人的胃疼明显缓解了。他再来复诊的时候，脸上的皱纹都舒展了，说话也有了力气。

“同志，你这药真管用。我这胃疼了好几年，吃了多少药都不见好，你这三副药下去，比什么都强。”老工人说着，眼眶红了。

王建新又改了药方，为他开了半个月的药剂，叮嘱他喝完再来复查。“回去按时吃药，别吃生冷硬的，少吃多餐。养胃是个慢功夫，不能急。”

老工人拿着药方，千恩万谢地走了。

消息传开了。来的人更多了。不光是首钢的工人，连附近工厂的、街道的、甚至石景山区外面的人都闻讯赶来。医务室门口每天都排着长队，从早上排到下午，有时候天黑了还有人。

张文华现在主动配合了。

他不再攥着药柜的钥匙不撒手了。刘晓东去取药，他主动把钥匙递过去，说“要什么你自己拿，登记一下就行”。他不再在工人面前说风凉话了。有工人问他“新来的大夫行不行”，他说“行，比行还行，人家是一等功臣，咱们得好好学”。他开始主动向王建新请教针灸技术了。

有一天下午，病人少了些，张文华端着一个搪瓷缸子走到王建新跟前，犹豫了好一会儿，才开口：“王队长，你那个针灸……能不能教教我？”

On the third day after the accident, Wang Jianxin was not idle.

He organized a health knowledge lecture in the factory auditorium.All members of the medical team and clinic attended, including Zhang Wenhua, who sat in the first row under the stage with a notebook spread out in front of him and a pen in his hand.This was the first time he took the initiative to sit in the front row.

The workers got off work and walked to the auditorium one after another.Some were wearing gray overalls, some were wearing blue overalls, and some were wearing hard hats with dust on them.Some smoked while walking, their cigarette butts flickering in the dusk.There were hundreds of people sitting in the auditorium. It was so dark that even the aisles were full.

Wang Jianxin stood on the stage, without any speech notes, just opened his mouth.

"Co-workers, we are here not only to see a doctor, but also to teach you how to get sick less often and not get sick." His voice was not loud, but everyone in the auditorium could hear him clearly."The great man said that prevention is the key. The best doctor is one who does not get sick."

He talks about workplace injury prevention.How to prevent steel billet deviation in the steel rolling workshop, how to prevent gas leakage in the blast furnace workshop, and how to prevent chemical burns in the coking workshop.He talked about specific things, without shouting slogans or reading documents, so the workers could listen.

"When you are working in the workshop, you must wear a safety helmet. Don't be too hot or too heavy. Isn't your head more valuable than your hat?" Someone in the audience laughed.

He teaches first aid.What to do if you get injured at work, how to stop bleeding, how to fix broken bones, and how to treat burns.He demonstrated while talking, using bandages, splints, and tourniquets to demonstrate everything.Liu Xiaodong stood by as the "injured" and was turned over and over by Wang Jianxin, tied up like a rice dumpling. The workers in the audience burst into laughter.

He talked about the prevention and treatment of common diseases.Back pain, knee pain, stomach pain, headache, how to prevent it, how to relieve it, when should you come to the infirmary, when should you go to the hospital.He speaks simply, you can understand and remember.

"After work, don't just drink and play cards. Go out for a walk and stretch your muscles and bones. Your body and bones are for the country, not for you to ruin."

He talks about personal hygiene.Wash your hands frequently, bathe frequently, and change clothes frequently.Don’t drink raw water in summer, and don’t freeze it in winter.Don't make do with eating, and don't make do with sleeping.

"You are sweating in the factory, and your wife and children at home are pointing at you. You have ruined your body, who can you deserve?"

Some people in the audience lowered their heads, and some wiped their eyes.

After the lecture, Wang Jianxin set up a simple medical consultation point at the entrance of the factory, which is open to the public every afternoon.A temporary shed with four wooden stakes supporting a canvas, a long table and a few folding chairs.There was a white cloth on the table, and there were a blood pressure monitor, a stethoscope, and a registration book.Liu Xiaodong wrote a sign with a brush - "Medical Consultation Point" and hung it in front of the shed. The writing was crooked, but he could see it clearly.

There was an endless stream of people coming.Some asked about back pain, some asked about knee pain, some asked about dizziness, and some asked about insomnia.Some workers do not go home after work. They first come to the consultation point to sit for a while, have their blood pressure taken, and ask questions about their health.Wang Jianxin answered the questions one by one without being impatient.He dealt with the issues that he could handle on the spot, and wrote down the issues that he couldn't deal with on paper and asked them to come to the infirmary the next day.

Liu Xiaodong registered next to him and wrote down his job number, name, workshop, chief complaint, and handling opinions in detail.After half a month, two thick volumes of registration books were used.

Wang Jianxin continued to see patients in the medical office.

This day an old worker came, about fifty years old, with a slightly hunched back and wrinkles on his face like knives.He held his stomach, walked in slowly, sat in front of the consultation table, and took a breath.

"Comrade, I've had stomach pain for several years. It hurts no matter what I eat. What should I do?"

Wang Jianxin asked him to lie down on the examination bed and explored it with his spiritual consciousness.Chronic atrophic gastritis, severe atrophy of gastric mucosa and intestinal metaplasia, are precancerous lesions.If it takes a few more years, it may be stomach cancer.

He used acupuncture to prick Zhongwan, Neiguan and Zusanli. When the silver needle penetrated, the spiritual power slowly penetrated and warmed the stomach.Then I prescribed a prescription - Xiangsha Liujunzi Decoction, with the addition and subtraction of Osmanthus sinensis, Amomum villosum, Codonopsis pilosula, Atractylodes macrocephala, Poria cocos, licorice, tangerine peel, pinellia, ginger and jujube.Strengthens the spleen and stomach, promotes qi and relieves pain.

After three doses of medicine, the old worker's stomach pain was significantly relieved.When he came back for follow-up consultation, the wrinkles on his face had softened and he had gained strength to speak.

"Comrade, this medicine of yours really works. I've had stomach pain for several years, and no matter how much medicine I take, it doesn't get better. These three medicines of yours are better than anything else." The old worker said, his eyes red.

Wang Jianxin changed the prescription again, prescribed the medicine for him for half a month, and told him to come back for a review after drinking it."Go back and take your medicine on time. Don't eat anything raw or hard. Eat smaller meals more frequently. Nourishment of the stomach is a slow process, so don't rush it."

The old worker took the prescription and left with a lot of gratitude.

Word spread.More people came.Not only workers from Shougang, but also people from nearby factories, streets, and even people outside Shijingshan District came after hearing the news.There is a long queue at the door of the infirmary every day, from morning to afternoon, and sometimes there are still people there after dark.

Zhang Wenhua is now actively cooperating.

He no longer held on to the key to the medicine cabinet.When Liu Xiaodong went to get the medicine, he took the initiative to hand over the key and said, "You can take whatever you want, just register it."He no longer makes sarcastic remarks in front of the workers.A worker asked him, "Is the new doctor good?" He said, "Yes, he is better than good. He is a first-class hero. We must learn from it."He began to take the initiative to ask Wang Jianxin for advice on acupuncture techniques.

One afternoon, when there were fewer patients, Zhang Wenhua walked up to Wang Jianxin with an enamel jar. He hesitated for a while before speaking: "Captain Wang, can you teach me acupuncture...?"
